technology_name: Killimangalam Kora Grass Mats: Traditional Woven Craft
problem_solved: Protecting traditional knowledge and boosting market visibility for an eco-friendly artisan craft through Geographical Indication.
description: Killimangalam Kora Grass Mats are a traditional craft woven using fine-count kora grass (Cyperus spp.) in the Thrissur and Palakkad districts. Traditionally practiced by the Kurava community, the craft involves the intricate weaving of coarse and fine mats using high-twist warp threads. Designs are culturally inspired, featuring palm leaves, elephants, and traditional attire. Recognized for their aesthetic value and eco-friendliness, the mats earned the UNESCO Seal of Excellence in 2004. KFRI has initiated the process to secure a Geographical Indication (GI) tag to protect this heritage and support weavers.
applications:
• Commercial retail of eco-friendly sleeping mats, yoga mats, carpets, and wall hangings

• Cultural tourism and export of premium traditional Indian handicrafts

• Empowerment and income generation for the rural Kurava artisan community

• Geographical Indication (GI) branding for authentic textile and home decor markets
